about.title: About Vmito
about.subtitle: The modern platform for badminton enthusiasts

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To simplify badminton session management and connect players with the best games in town.

hero.title: Badminton Made Simple
hero.subtitle: Join. Play. Track. Experience the future of badminton session management.

players.title: For Players
players.description: Focus on playing, not organizing. We handle the logistics so you can handle the shuttle.

find.title: Find Sessions Instantly
find.description: Discover sessions that match your skill level and schedule.

fairPlay.title: Fair Play Rotation
fairPlay.description: Our automated rotation system ensures everyone gets equal court time.

track.title: Track Your Stats

q1.question: Is it free to use?
q1.answer: Yes, Vmito is free for players. Hosts have access to premium features for a small fee.

q2.question: How are skill levels determined?
q2.answer: We use a self-rating system combined with match history to ensure balanced games.

q3.question: Can I book courts through the app?
q3.answer: Currently, we focus on session management. Court booking features are coming soon.

hero.title: User Guide

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Just 3 simple steps to start using Vmito.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Sign up with email or quickly log in via Google. It only takes a few seconds.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Log in with email/password or your Google account to access all features.

profile.description: Set your name, avatar, and badminton skill level (Y-, Y, Y+, TBY, TB-, TB, TB+, K) so hosts and other players know about you.

filter.description: Filter by skill level, fee type (fixed/split), price range, and time of day. Filters are saved automatically.
